items.why_en: Meshy's new foundation model focused on improving alignment between input images and generated 3D results.

monthly.note: 本月(2026 年 10 月)無最新正式發佈,故此榜單由最近期(2026 年 8 月至 9 月)的正式發佈補足。
monthly.note_en: No new official releases were found for this month (October 2026), so this list is supplemented with recent official releases from August to September 2026.

items.name: Meshy 7
items.why: 針對現有自動綁骨與動畫 API 進行了功能擴展與優化，提升了自動綁骨的靈活性和動畫應用。
items.why_en: Expanded and optimized existing auto-rigging and animation APIs, enhancing flexibility in auto-rigging and animation application.

items.name: Autodesk Flow Studio
items.why: 引入了 3D 編輯器與畫布功能，將 AI 綁骨整合到更全面的場景搭建與動畫製作流程中。
items.why_en: Introduced 3D Editor + Canvas features, integrating AI rigging into a more comprehensive scene building and animation production workflow.

items.name: Tripo P2.0
items.why: 推出最新的 AI 模型，提升了 3D 資產生成能力，並支援自動生成角色、服裝及配件，間接強化綁骨流程。
items.why_en: Released the latest AI model, enhancing 3D asset generation capabilities and supporting automatic generation of characters, clothing, and accessories, indirectly strengthening the rigging process.

items.name: Bake3D
items.why: 全新的 AI 驅動平台，提供從圖像到紋理 3D 模型、角色綁骨和動畫的一站式工作流程。
items.why_en: A new AI-powered platform offering a one-stop workflow from image to textured 3D models, character rigging, and animation.

items.name: Animcraft 6.0
items.why: 引入了全新的 AI 角色綁骨與蒙皮模組，顯著提升了其動畫庫構建工具的自動化能力。
items.why_en: Introduced a new AI character rigging and skinning module, significantly enhancing the automation capabilities of its animation library building tools.

overall.why_en: Most complete game-audio stack: text-to-SFX (30s, seamless loops) + top-tier voice

overall.name: Suno v5
overall.why: 音樂盲測第一(ELO 1293);全曲+人聲質量標竿
overall.why_en: #1 in music blind tests (ELO 1293); full-song + vocal benchmark

overall.name: ElevenLabs Music v2
overall.why: 商用授權清晰,可在曲中嵌 SFX、中途換曲風
overall.why_en: Clear commercial licensing; embed SFX in tracks, mid-track genre switch

overall.name: Stable Audio 3
overall.why: 開源,音樂 + SFX/foley 統一,適合自架 pipeline
overall.why_en: Open-source; unified music + SFX/foley; great for self-hosted pipelines

overall.name: Lyria 3 Pro
overall.why: 最長 3 分鐘結構化曲目,SynthID 浮水印
overall.why_en: Up to 3-min structured tracks; SynthID watermark

items.name: Suno
items.why: Suno 的旗艦音樂生成模型重大更新,與華納音樂集團等業界夥伴共同開發,提供更佳的音樂創作體驗。
items.why_en: Major update to Suno's flagship music generation model, co-developed with industry partners like Warner Music Group, offering an enhanced music creation experience.

items.name: Lyria
items.why: Google 音樂生成模型的顯著升級,能產生更豐富的編曲和連貫的歌曲,並整合至多個 Google 產品中。
items.why_en: A significant upgrade to Google's music generation model, capable of producing richer arrangements and coherent songs, integrated across multiple Google products.

items.name: Eleven
items.why: ElevenLabs 旗艦語音模型的重大升級,提升了語音表現力、真實感及多語言支援,適用於文字轉語音和語音複製。
items.why_en: A substantial upgrade to ElevenLabs' flagship voice models, enhancing expressiveness, realism, and multilingual support for text-to-speech and voice cloning.

items.name: MAI-Voice
items.why: 微軟推出的全新多語言文字轉語音模型,具備跨語言一致語音和低延遲高效能等先進功能。
items.why_en: New multilingual text-to-speech models from Microsoft, offering advanced features such as consistent voice across languages and optimized low-latency performance.

items.name: Gemini Live
items.why: Google 推出的全新語音轉語音模型,專注於自然、低延遲的對話式 AI 體驗,並支援多步驟推理。
items.why_en: New speech-to-speech models from Google, focusing on natural, low-latency conversational AI experiences with multi-step reasoning capabilities.
